title: Tabular Data Generator
summary: A Gaussian Mixture Model - Variational Autoencoder synthesizer for tabular data, built to generate synthetic health records such as the cardiovascular-disease dataset. The codebase imports SDV's dataset-loading and metadata utilities to prepare data and sdmetrics' QualityReport to evaluate the synthetic output, while the actual generative model is a custom GMM-VAE rather than an SDV synthesizer.
evidence: datasets/main_datasets.py:8-10 imports sdv.datasets.demo.download_demo, sdv.datasets.local.load_csvs, sdv.metadata.Metadata; validation.py:11 imports sdmetrics.reports.single_table.QualityReport
